name: text-line-mask-rise
title: Masked Line Rise
description: Mỗi dòng trồi lên khỏi mặt nạ riêng trong 1 giây, dòng sau cách dòng trước 0.1 giây, dừng rất êm.

moworks.author: takayu

options.exit: s after the start to rise out (null: stay)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-line-mask-rise, written here): Split lines, each in an overflow-clip mask (demo: baseline − 0.98 em to + 0.3 em, 8 px side pad). Each line yPercent 100 → 0 (rises one mask height), 1 s expo.out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); power4.out also given), lines 0.1 s apart from 0.3 s. Demo exit: lines continue up out of the mask, 0.6 s easeInCubic, 0.1 s apart, from 2.9 s; loop 4 s. Params: duration (1 s) · stagger: giữa các dòng (0.1 s) · ease (expo.out).
moworks.titleVi: Từng dòng trồi lên, dừng êm
